title: Canary deployments
summary: A canary deployment exposes a change to limited production traffic before expanding its rollout.
overview: Compare the candidate with a control using signals tied to user impact. The evaluation must drive a decision to promote, pause, or roll back.
why: Small exposure can reveal production-only failures before they affect everyone.
example: Route five percent of API traffic to a new release and compare error rate and latency by version before increasing traffic.
judgment: Choose representative traffic, sufficient observation time, failure thresholds, and a viable rollback path.
